w12Structure.generatedOwnership: Generated bodies unchanged in STRUCTURE-1; internal/generated physical relocation and generator adoption tracked separately in STRUCTURE-2.

featureCoverage.scope: Extends the existing inventory in place; every public declaration maps to current definition owners or UNIMPLEMENTED. No behavior completion inferred.
featureCoverage.exclusions: Material M2/useMaterial3/applyElevationOverlayColor/2014/2018 and deprecated APIs per work12 section0; shared M3/value contracts remain eligible.

generatorProtection.scope: Historical extractor fails before source traversal; adopted W12 mapping bytes remain unchanged
